title: 摩根士丹利王滢：监管层多措并举，市场稳定信号非常清晰
speaker: Laura Wang

segments.en: In addition to that, actually Beijing most recently had actually hosted multiple meetings to urge companies and government-backed institutional funds, number one to buy equities, and number two
segments.zh: 此外，北京最近召开了多次会议，敦促企业和政府支持的机构资金，第一买入权益资产，第二

segments.en: to ask national team to accelerate buying. And number three, very importantly, they've also asked insurance companies to reassess their equity positions and not to unload underwater positions
segments.zh: 要求国家队加快买入。第三，非常重要的一点，他们还要求保险公司重新评估其权益资产仓位，不要在这个时候将浮亏仓位抛向市场

segments.en: into the market at this moment. And Mr. Wuqing, the CSRC chairman most recently at the Financial Street Forum, also mentioned that stability is the number one priority for the market at the moment.
segments.zh: 证监会主席吴清最近在金融街论坛上也提到，稳定是当前市场的首要任务。

segments.en: So we think with the combination of the three, the signal is very loud and clear.
segments.zh: 因此我们认为，这三者结合，信号非常响亮清晰。
